elements_selected.content: Create the test infrastructure skeleton. Files: tests/conftest.py (shared fixtures, config patching, session state reset, DB fixture loading), tests/fixtures/test_config.toml (minimal Sense config for tests — points at fixture corpus, uses fixture DB path, has known classification rules and decay settings). Add pytest and pytest dependencies to pyproject.toml under [project.optional-dependencies] test group. Create tests/__init__.py. Verify pytest discovers and runs with zero tests collected.
